subject: Action: CPPO cost attribution & tax-entity mapping for Reseller AgoraTech
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia@agoratech.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Ramos <victor@agoratech.io>
Date: 2027-06-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Action: CPPO cost attribution & tax-entity mapping for Reseller AgoraTech

Hi Markus —

Thanks for taking this on. We're moving to a Channel Private Offer (CPPO) with our US reseller entity (AgoraTech, LLC) and AWS Marketplace asked us to provide a clear mapping of billing/tax entities and how cost attribution will flow so they can approve the private offer.

Summary of what they asked for:
- Legal entity name used for Marketplace invoices (we're AgoraTech, LLC).
- Tax form (W-9 for US entities, or W-8 for foreign).
- Which Marketplace Product SKU maps to Redwood's listing and how usage/cost will be attributed to AgoraTech for reporting.
- Contact for procurement + AP for DocuSign and invoicing.

Attaching our W-9 and a quick inventory of reseller SKUs. Can you confirm Redwood's preferred flow (Marketplace -> Redwood invoiced to AgoraTech -> reseller collects from end-customer, or a different pattern)? Also, can you attach the minimal evidence AWS wants for CPPO approval so we can send to our finance team?

Goal: get CPPO approved this month so we can finish co-sell registration.

Thanks,
Alicia Moreno
Head of Partnerships | AgoraTech
A: +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: AgoraTech_W9.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Action: CPPO cost attribution & tax-entity mapping for Reseller AgoraTech

Alicia —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we can support AgoraTech as the billed Marketplace entity (AgoraTech, LLC) and provide the SKU mapping. AWS typically requires a tax form on file and a product-SKU to listing mapping for CPPO approval. We will need:

- Official AP contact for AgoraTech (name, email, PO routing instructions).
- Confirmation whether AgoraTech wants Redwood to invoice them monthly for aggregated Marketplace usage, or if they want AWS to bill them directly (Marketplace settlement model).

I've looped in Ben (Marketplace ops) and Tessa (partner finance) to lay out the steps and the evidence package. I attached a simple flow diagram and a draft MPA clause we use for reseller CPPOs.

Proposed next steps (can we hit these by next Tue?):
1) AgoraTech confirms AP contact + preferred invoice flow.
2) Redwood provides SKU -> listing mapping + sample invoice fields for AWS.
3) AWS CPPO submission (we'll hand this off to Ben for the Marketplace ticket).
4) Sign MPA addendum / DocuSign.

If you're comfortable, please send AP contact and I'll start the AWS ticket.

—Markus Klein

Markus / team —

Quick note from Marketplace ops: AWS's CPPO intake expects a few specific fields on the Private Offer request:
- Marketplace product SKU(s) (exact match to listing).
- "BillingEntityId" or tax entity name (to match tax docs).
- Attribution pattern ("MarketplaceSettledToReseller" vs "RedwoodSettledToReseller").
- Any invoice split or reseller margin fields documented.

I've pulled together a short checklist and the minimum evidence they accept — attaching now. We should also confirm whether AgoraTech is US-taxed or foreign (their W-9 suggests US). If they have any special VAT/VAT registration (EU/APAC) we need those docs too.

Operational ask: Markus — please confirm the SKU list you'd like us to tie to AgoraTech's CPPO and whether you want Redwood to remain the ultimate invoice recipient (we can still provide reseller reporting) or pass billing to AgoraTech via AWS settlement. The fastest path for CPPO approval is to map the SKU and have the W-9 on file with Marketplace.

Ben
Ben Carter
Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference

- AP contact: Victor Ramos, victor@agoratech.io, +1 (415) 555-0199. We prefer Redwood to invoice AgoraTech monthly (aggregated usage), then AgoraTech will handle downstream collections.

Per Ben's note, we confirm US entity for the primary CPPO. We're okay with Redwood remaining the invoice recipient for the first 90 days while we validate the settlement. If AWS requires the BillingEntityId, our legal entity UUID is AG-88921.

Could you send the CPPO submission packet and a DocuSign for the MPA addendum? We'll sign once AWS confirms CPPO mapping.
